name: HBR WisdomDownRate icon
transformation: Original texture with a programmatic corner arrow composited over it (Pillow polygon, 8x supersampled, blue down arrow with a dark outline, bottom-right corner). No resizing, recoloring of the original pixels outside the arrow, crop or AI generation. Reason: the original IconWisdom is the attribute icon shared by its rises and falls; the arrow marks the down variant, the same arrow as the spirit-down icon.

usage.note: The original has one 64x64 Texture2D; both icon roles reuse it.

limits: Original icon asset identity and provenance only. No Godot importer, package or game run was performed.
